purpose: Natural English speech, accent, expressive delivery, and character performance

cases.text: At first light, the city seems almost still. Delivery trucks turn onto empty streets, kitchen lights come on, and the day begins before most people notice.
cases.voice_design: A natural adult American woman with a warm, grounded documentary voice. Clear but not over-enunciated, conversational pacing, subtle breath, no announcer affect.
cases.custom_instruction: Speak naturally and calmly, like a thoughtful documentary narrator. Avoid a promotional tone.

cases.text: We tend to imagine progress as a straight road. In practice, it is a series of detours, revisions, and decisions made with incomplete information.
cases.voice_design: A natural adult British man from southern England, educated contemporary accent rather than theatrical RP. Reflective, measured, intimate studio narration.

cases.text: The interesting part is not the amount of data. It is the pattern hiding inside it, and whether that pattern still holds when the conditions change.
cases.voice_design: A natural adult Indian woman speaking fluent English, educated urban Indian accent, confident and relaxed. Authentic everyday delivery, never exaggerated or caricatured.

cases.text: Look, I hear you. But if we're going to change the plan, let's do it now, while we still have room to make it work.
cases.voice_design: A natural young adult Black American man in an informal urban conversation. Contemporary General American speech with subtle African-American cadence; intelligent and restrained, no stereotype, no parody.
cases.custom_instruction: Keep it informal, direct, and conversational, with natural rhythm. Do not sound like an announcer.

cases.text: Keep your voice down. There is someone in the next room, and I do not want them to know we are still awake.
cases.voice_design: An adult American woman whispering very softly at close range, intimate and cautious, with audible breath but clean diction. Genuine whisper, not merely quiet speech.
cases.custom_instruction: Whisper quietly and cautiously, close to the microphone, while keeping the words intelligible.

cases.text: I kept the light on because some part of me still expected you to walk through the door. I know that does not make sense anymore.
cases.voice_design: An adult British woman holding back grief. The voice is fragile and tired, with small pauses and one unsteady breath, but no melodrama and no crying performance.

cases.text: Step away from the railing. Do it slowly, and keep your eyes on me. We have time, but I need you to listen now.
cases.voice_design: An adult American man speaking with controlled urgency. Firm, focused, reassuring under pressure; slightly faster than normal without shouting.
cases.custom_instruction: Use controlled urgency: firm and focused, slightly faster than normal, but do not shout.

cases.text: There it is. After all those years of looking, the signal was waiting in the quietest part of the sky.
cases.voice_design: A natural adult American woman experiencing quiet wonder. Begin almost under the breath, then allow warmth and amazement to grow without becoming theatrical.
cases.custom_instruction: Start softly with quiet wonder, then let restrained amazement grow toward the end.

cases.text: Good news: I found the map. Less good news: the map is currently underneath a dragon who appears to be a very light sleeper.
cases.voice_design: A small animated fantasy creature: bright, quick, mischievous, and endearing. Comic timing and lively pitch changes, but every word remains clear.

cases.text: The sea was calm that morning, which should have warned us. Out there, calm water often means something below is listening.
cases.voice_design: An elderly Irish man with a weathered, believable voice and a mild natural Irish accent. Slow fireside storytelling, dry warmth, never a cartoon pirate.

cases.text: On Thursday, February nineteenth, Dr. Maya Chen approved version 3.7. The total was 14,805 dollars and 60 cents, reference code A Z nine forty-two.
cases.voice_design: A natural American English studio voice reading practical information clearly. Neutral pace, precise names, dates, numbers, letters, and punctuation; no robotic cadence.
cases.custom_instruction: Read this practical information naturally, with special care for names, dates, numbers, and the reference code.
